segments.orig:
âca manô mata âca ýazamaide vanguhîmca
âdãm vanguhîmca ashîm vanguhîmca
cistîm vanguhîmca drvatâtem avi ratûsh
avi rathwya gereñte.
segments.en:
(Yea,) we sacrifice to the thoughts of the mind, and to the
good wisdom, and to the good and blessed sanctity, and to the
good religious knowledge, and to good health (of soul and body).
[At their (several) seasons, and with the presence of seasonable
circumstances, they are hymned.] 2. Confession is to be made for
the Kine; we, Zarathushtrian Mazdayasnians, celebrate at the sacrificial
time for the Myazda-offering, at the time for the Ratufriti, the
prayer for blessings, for the sacrificial worship, homage, propitiation,
and praise of the entire creation of the holy (and the clean). 1. This section, preceding Y. 11, closed in the B.V.S., seems to me 
 to belong properly after Yasna 8, and the Myazda offering with 
 the Ratufrîti.
